policy2018.title: ECB: Deconstructing Monetary Policy Surprises
policy2018.supported_scope: Policy and information shocks have different interpretations; observational sign classification is imperfect.

quants2008.title: Khandani and Lo: What Happened to the Quants in August 2007?
quants2008.supported_scope: Transaction/factor analysis supports deleveraging and withdrawal of liquidity; simulations do not identify every actual fund position.

earnings2007.title: Lamont and Frazzini: Earnings Announcement Premium and Trading Volume
earnings2007.supported_scope: Announcement attention and volume can move prices separately from incremental earnings information.

profit2010.title: Novy-Marx: The Other Side of Value
profit2010.supported_scope: Gross profitability and valuation are jointly informative in the study; long-short historical evidence is not a long-only trading guarantee.

quality2018.title: Asness, Frazzini and Pedersen: Quality Minus Junk
quality2018.supported_scope: Global quality research supports examining profitability, growth and safety; source evidence is largely long-short.

oil2015.title: Bank of England: Oil price falls, what consequences for monetary policy?
oil2015.supported_scope: The supply/demand distinction changes the interpretation of the 2014-15 oil price decline.

commerce2019.title: Amiti, Redding and Weinstein: The Impact of the 2018 Trade War
commerce2019.supported_scope: 2018 tariff incidence affected domestic input/final prices; protecting output does not remove input costs.

manufacturing2019.title: Flaaen and Pierce: Disentangling the Effects of 2018-2019 Tariffs
manufacturing2019.supported_scope: Import protection, input costs and retaliation must be considered jointly; manufacturing effects contradict simple sector beneficiary claims.

momentum2016.title: Daniel and Moskowitz: Momentum Crashes
momentum2016.supported_scope: Rebounds of prior losers can hurt long-short momentum after market stress; this is not the same payoff as a long-only trend strategy.

vol2016.title: Moreira and Muir: Volatility Managed Portfolios
vol2016.supported_scope: The paper reports improved historical risk-adjusted outcomes from volatility scaling across selected factors.

vol2020.title: Cederburg et al.: On the performance of volatility-managed portfolios
vol2020.supported_scope: Broader 103-strategy tests do not systematically favor managed portfolios; ex post spanning weights are not executable in real time.

etf2014.title: Ben-David, Franzoni and Moussawi: Do ETFs Increase Volatility?
etf2014.supported_scope: ETF arbitrage links can transmit non-fundamental volatility; ETF ownership alone does not identify a directional return.

flash2010.title: Joint CFTC-SEC report on the May 6, 2010 market events
flash2010.supported_scope: The event shows severe dislocations including ETFs and rapid recovery; it does not establish a general daily dip-buying rule.
